description: This file contains the implementation of the SQSStorage class, a helper/wrapper for AWS SQS queue operations including queue initialization, message sending, retrieval, and deletion, with configuration parsing and error handling.

classes.name: SQSStorage
classes.description: A class providing methods to interact with AWS SQS queues, including creating, deleting, sending, and receiving messages, with configuration parsing and error handling.

methods.name: SQSStorage
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SQSStorage instance with logger, queue name, connection string, and optional service ID.

methods.name: ParseDataConnectionString
methods.description: Parses the connection string to extract service URL, access key, and secret key.

methods.name: CreateClient
methods.description: Creates the AmazonSQSClient based on the parsed configuration, supporting local, explicit credentials, or implicit auth.

methods.name: GetQueueUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the URL of the SQS queue asynchronously.

methods.name: InitQueueAsync
methods.description: Initializes the queue by creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: AddMessage
methods.description: Adds a message to the SQS queue.

methods.name: GetMessages
methods.description: Retrieves messages from the SQS queue, up to a specified count.

methods.name: DeleteMessage
methods.description: Deletes a specific message from the queue.

methods.name: ReportErrorAndRethrow
methods.description: Logs an error and rethrows it as an AggregateException.

methods.name: LogErrorSQSOperation
methods.description: Partial method for logging errors during SQS operations.
